# Kamil Wyremski - Full Stack Web Developer

> Polish Full Stack Web Developer. Builds custom web applications and sells turn-key PHP scripts for classifieds, job boards, real estate, automotive, and directory websites.

Kamil Wyremski is based in Poland and has been building web applications since the early 2010s. He specialises in PHP, Symfony, React.js, and MySQL. The site is available in Polish and English.

## Technical Skills

- **Backend**: PHP 7.x / 8.x, Symfony, Node.js, REST APIs
- **Frontend**: JavaScript ES6+, React.js, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, SASS/SCSS, Bootstrap
- **Database**: MySQL, MariaDB
- **Tools**: Git, Composer, npm, Webpack, Docker, PWA

## Web Scripts

### Notice3 — Classifieds Portal Script
- English: https://wyremski.pl/en/script/notice3
- Polish: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/notice3
- Framework: Symfony + Vue.js + Bootstrap 5
- Payments: Przelewy24, HotPay, PayPal, Tpay, PayU, Paynow, Autopay, Paybylink, Revolut Pay, bank transfer
- Features: multi-language, paid ad promotion, map search (Google Maps), social login (Facebook, Google), internal messaging, newsletter module, voice search, commenting, user wallet, YouTube embeds

### Motonotice — Automotive Classifieds Script
- English: https://wyremski.pl/en/script/motonotice
- Polish: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/motonotice
- Features: vehicle parameter filters (mileage, engine size, year, body type), photo galleries, contact forms, map integration

### Jobnotice — Job Board Script
- English: https://wyremski.pl/en/script/jobnotice
- Polish: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/jobnotice
- Features: employer profiles, CV uploads, category and location filtering, paid job postings

### Cuadro — Real Estate Portal Script
- English: https://wyremski.pl/en/script/cuadro
- Polish: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/cuadro
- Features: property listings with details (sqm, rooms, floor, amenities), map integration, lead contact forms

### Festa2 — Events & Directory Script
- English: https://wyremski.pl/en/script/festa2
- Polish: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/festa2
- Features: business listings, regional events, category management

### Holmes2 — Business Directory Script
- English: https://wyremski.pl/en/script/holmes2
- Polish: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/holmes2
- Features: business profiles, ratings, map search

### Demoty2 — Meme & Viral Media Script
- English: https://wyremski.pl/en/script/demoty2
- Polish: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/demoty2
- Features: media upload (images/videos), voting and commenting, moderation panel, social sharing

### Corta — URL Shortener Script
- English: https://wyremski.pl/en/script/corta
- Polish: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/corta
- Features: analytics, click tracking, custom short URLs
